source.author: verg
source.text: praesensit, motusque excepit prima futuros, omnia tuta timens.
source.text_original: praesensit, motusque excepit prima futuros, / omnia tuta timens.
source.text_english: she foresaw it and first caught the future movements, fearing that all was safe.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Haec dicta sint non infausto contra te uaticinio, sed pauidi cautique monitoris officio ea quoque in te, quae tuta sunt, formidantis.
reuse.text_original: Haec dicta sint non infausto contra te uaticinio, sed pauidi cautique monitoris officio ea quoque in te, quae tuta sunt, formidantis.
reuse.text_english: Let these words be spoken not as an ill-omened prophecy against you, but as the duty of a fearful and cautious adviser, one who is afraid for you even in those things that are safe.
